images.role: hook strobe / loop frame + slowdown + hold 7
images.note: D1 full-view reeded-glass garage door in a bronze-anodized aluminum frame, glowing amber
D2 oxblood-red arched carriage-house doors with arched windows and iron strap hinges
D3 bone-white flush smooth steel door with hairline reveals, no handle
D4 matte-black aluminum full-view door with clear 4x5 glass grid showing the lit workshop
D5 concealed door clad in the same moss-green board-and-batten as the walls
D6 horizontal clear western red cedar slat door, honey-copper in the low sun
D7 espresso thermally modified ash vertical tongue-and-groove door with blackened-steel bar pull
D8 mid-century cream steel door with raised diamond-lattice moulding and square windows
D9 corten weathering-steel door laser-cut as a Douglas fir forest, glowing from inside
D10 slate-blue vertical-groove door with a frosted glass band across the top

idea: One clear, cold January late afternoon in front of the two-car garage of a 1962 Portland Northwest-modern post-and-beam ranch, shot from one locked frame, cycling through 10 garage doors from a bronze reeded-glass door to a corten steel door laser-cut as a glowing Douglas fir forest.
